phone_protocol_match.definition: Identical initial camera[4,-8,6]->[0,0,0]. Same drag/pinch CDP screen points and ended-ID2/remaining-ID1 stream. Deliberate targets are same world points[0,0,0]/[1,0,0]; screen coordinates intentionally project through each actual camera. Natural wall timing/damping may vary slightly; no forced camera reset after framing.

visibility_qa.criterion: Within canvas crop x0:390 y110:520, count B>R+25 and B>G+5. Excludes top toast/nav and bottom controls. Real PNG/raw JPEG pixels; no UI alteration.

evidence.visual_inspection: Actual first-pin PNG, Undo PNG and decoded MP4 contact were inspected. Final firstpin/Done/Undo retain woodfloor and expected blue pins; empty-world Add robot overlay absent once pins exist. Initial camera was not moved closer.

preserved_attempts.phone-before-v1: Successful earlier baseline with superseded world tap targets[0,-1.5,.01]/[1,-1.5,.01]; retained.
preserved_attempts.phone-after-v1: Harness target projected under placement panel after pinch, first deliberate tap timed out. Log, raw frames, manifest and harness snapshot retained.
preserved_attempts.phone-after-v2: Preceding candidate c50 passed gesture/worldcounts but actual visual QA found firstpin/Undo content100%fog and intrusive NoRobots overlay. Root fixed both; v2 retained as evidence of product defect, not final approval.
preserved_attempts.fixed-A1/B1/A2/B2: Preceding c50 comparison retained. Final claims use independent fixed-final-A1/B1/A2/B2 runs.
